$comment: Every MindAttic scheduled job. install.ps1 registers each one under \MindAttic\WatchDog\ (HOUSE-LAW-11), wrapped in conhost --headless. See README.md for the fields.

jobs.name: Automata.Tick
jobs.description: Automata heartbeat: resumes parked runs and runs whatever is due. Runs only while you are logged on, because browser lanes cannot render in session 0.

jobs.name: Launcher.NightlyBackup
jobs.description: Launcher nightly backup at midnight, keeping the newest 30. Runs while you are logged on; a missed midnight runs as soon as the machine is next available.

jobs.name: IdiotProof.ResearchScan
jobs.description: IdiotProof research scanner: one scan pass an hour so the /research tab has fresh data. Runs as you (LocalDB and the Vault keyrings are user-scoped) while you are logged on. Publish it first: dotnet publish IdiotProof.ResearchScanner -c Release -o C:\Apps\IdiotProof\ResearchScanner --no-self-contained.
